ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a transition-state schematic structure. The main components include an EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et fragment and the :PPh3 below, and there are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring arrows. Then reason: Expand abbreviations according to the specified method. EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et has two ethoxycarbonyl side chains and one N=N bond. Each side chain contains C=O, C–O, O–CH2, CH2–CH3, and C–N, for a total of 5 non-hydrogen bonds; the two side chains are 2 × 5 = 10, plus 1 N=N bond, for a total of 11. PPh3 contains three benzene rings and three P–C bonds; each benzene ring is counted as 6 intraring C–C bonds, so the three benzene rings are 3 × 6 = 18, plus the three P–C bonds gives 21. The total number of bonds is 11 + 21 = 32.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Expand the abbreviations from the image. Count EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et as two ethoxycarbonyl sides plus the N=N bond: each side has C=O, C–O, O–CH2, CH2–CH3, and C–N = 5 bonds, so 2×5 + 1 = 11. Count PPh3 as three phenyl rings plus three P–C bonds: 3×6 + 3 = 21. Add all components: 11 + 21 = 32.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中显示一个过渡态示意结构，主要组分包括 EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et 片段和下方的 :PPh3，图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。再推理：按指定方法展开缩写。EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et 有两个 ethoxycarbonyl 侧链和一个 N=N 键。每个侧链包含 C=O、C–O、O–CH2、CH2–CH3、C–N，共 5 个非氢键；两个侧链为 2 × 5 = 10 个，再加 N=N 键 1 个，共 11 个。PPh3 包含三个苯环和三个 P–C 键；每个苯环按 6 个环内 C–C 键计数，三个苯环为 3 × 6 = 18 个，加三个 P–C 键为 21 个。总键数为 11 + 21 = 32。

method.method_draft: Build the non-H connectivity graph. For EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et, the heavy-atom degree sum is: two carbonyl carbons 2×3, two carbonyl oxygens 2×1, two alkoxy oxygens 2×2, two O–CH2 carbons 2×2, two terminal ethyl carbons 2×1, and two nitrogens 2×2, giving 22; divide by 2 to get 11 bonds. For PPh3, P has degree 3; in each phenyl group the ipso carbon has degree 3 and the other five ring carbons degree 2, so per ring degree sum is 13; total degree sum is 3 + 3×13 = 42, giving 21 bonds. Sum 11 + 21 = 32.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态结构，主体为 EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et，即左右各有一个乙氧羰基连接到偶氮 N=N 片段；下方还显示 :PPh3（三苯基膦）组分。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按非氢原子连通键计数。对于 EtO2C–N=N–CO2Et，重原子度数和为：两个羰基碳 2×3，两个羰基氧 2×1，两个烷氧基氧 2×2，两个 O–CH2 碳 2×2，两个末端乙基碳 2×1，两个氮 2×2，总度数为 6+2+4+4+2+4=22；每条键贡献两个端点，所以键数为 22/2=11。对于 PPh3，P 与三个苯基相连，P 的度数为 3；每个苯基中，ipso 碳连接 P 和两个环碳，度数为 3，其余五个环碳各度数为 2，所以每个苯基对应度数和为 3+5×2=13。三苯基加 P 的总度数为 3+3×13=42，键数为 42/2=21。总键数为 11+21=32。
